questions.question: During a basic vehicle control skills test, what is a look?

options.text: Getting out of the vehicle and walking to the back to check its position
Using side mirrors to check the vehicle's position
Looking out the driver's side window to check the vehicle's position
A driver glancing over their shoulder to check blind spots

questions.correctAnswerText: Getting out of the vehicle and walking to the back to check its position
questions.explanation: A look is when the driver opens the door, leaves the seat, and walks to the back of the vehicle to check its position. During straight line backing, you can use only one look. During other exercises, you can use up to two looks.

questions.question: A properly adjusted outside convex mirror should allow the driver to see:

options.text: Where the front of each rear tire touches the ground
Where the front of each front tire touches the ground
The top of the bus
The muffler

questions.correctAnswerText: Where the front of each rear tire touches the ground
questions.explanation: On a school bus, the outside convex mirrors should show: at least one traffic lane on each side of the bus, the entire side of the bus up to the mirror mounts, and where the front of each rear tire touches the ground.

questions.question: A properly adjusted outside mirror should allow the driver to see how far behind the bus?

options.text: One bus length
Two bus lengths
Three bus lengths
Four bus lengths

questions.correctAnswerText: Four bus lengths
questions.explanation: The left and right side flat mirrors on a school bus should be adjusted so the driver can see 200 feet (or four bus lengths) behind the bus.

questions.question: Before leaving a bus stop, the driver should:

options.text: Make sure no students are running to catch the bus
Make sure students have put their backpacks in the aisle
Make sure students have opened the emergency vent
Make sure students are facing the rear of the bus

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure no students are running to catch the bus
questions.explanation: Before pulling away from a bus stop, the driver should check that no students are running to catch the bus.

questions.question: When doing a driver's side parallel parking maneuver, you should:

options.text: Pass the parking space while backing, then pull forward into it
Pull forward past the parking space, then back into it
Pull forward into the parking space without passing it first
Back into the parking space without passing it first

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull forward past the parking space, then back into it
questions.explanation: Drive past the parking space on your left. Then back into it, bringing the rear of your vehicle close to the rear of the space. Your vehicle must be completely within the space boundaries.

questions.question: If a student drops an item near a stopped bus, they should:

options.text: Hurry and pick up the item
Leave the item behind
Ask the driver to pick up the item
Have another student pick it up

questions.correctAnswerText: Ask the driver to pick up the item
questions.explanation: It is dangerous for students to pick up dropped items because they could disappear from the driver's view. If an item is dropped, the student should move away from the bus, get the driver's attention, and ask the driver to retrieve it.

questions.question: During a basic vehicle control skills test, you may be asked to:

options.text: Alley dock
Parallel park to your right
Parallel park to your left
All of the above

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above
questions.explanation: The basic vehicle control skills test may include: straight line backing, offset back/right parking, offset back/left parking, driver side parallel parking, conventional parallel parking, and alley docking.

questions.question: During the on-road driving test, you must do all of the following, except:

options.text: Wear your safety belt
Obey all traffic laws
Complete the test without a moving violation
Obey traffic signs and signals only if other traffic is present

questions.correctAnswerText: Obey traffic signs and signals only if other traffic is present
questions.explanation: You must drive safely during the on-road test. This means wearing your safety belt, obeying all traffic signs and signals at all times, following all traffic laws, and avoiding accidents and moving violations.

questions.question: When alley docking, your vehicle should be parked:

options.text: With the front bumper on the front boundary line
With the rear wheels over the rear boundary line
Straight within the boundaries of the parking space
At an angle within the boundaries of the parking space

questions.correctAnswerText: Straight within the boundaries of the parking space
questions.explanation: When alley docking, drive past the alley and stop parallel to the outer boundary. Then back your vehicle straight into the alley. Your vehicle must be parked straight and entirely within the space boundaries.

questions.question: During the skills test, if you must stop before making a turn, you should:

options.text: Skid to a stop
Stop after the stop line to get a better view
Allow your vehicle to roll
Keep the front wheels aimed straight ahead

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep the front wheels aimed straight ahead
questions.explanation: Come to a smooth stop behind any stop line, crosswalk, or stop sign. Keep your front wheels straight and do not let the vehicle roll. If stopping behind another vehicle, stop where you can still see its rear tires.

questions.question: When properly adjusted, school bus mirrors allow the driver to see ____ behind the bus.

options.text: One bus length
Two bus lengths
Three bus lengths
Four bus lengths

questions.correctAnswerText: Four bus lengths
questions.explanation: Proper mirror adjustment is important for safe school bus operation. Flat mirrors should be adjusted so the driver can see 200 feet, or four bus lengths, behind the bus.

questions.question: During a vehicle inspection, you must check all of the following except:

options.text: That the oil pressure gauge is working.
That the oil pressure warning light turns off, or that the gauge shows increasing or normal oil pressure.
That the oil temperature gauge, if equipped, rises to the normal operating range.
That the oil pressure gauge comes on when brakes are used.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the oil pressure gauge comes on when brakes are used.
questions.explanation: When checking the oil pressure gauge during a vehicle inspection, make sure it is working. The gauge should show increasing or normal oil pressure, or the oil pressure warning light should turn off. If the vehicle has an oil temperature gauge, it should gradually rise to the normal operating range.

questions.question: During the on-road driving test, you must do all of the following except:

options.text: Wear your safety belt.
Obey all traffic signs.
Complete the test without an accident.
Demonstrate that you can use your cell phone while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Demonstrate that you can use your cell phone while driving.
questions.explanation: During the on-road driving test, you must drive safely and responsibly. Wear your safety belt, obey all traffic signs and signals, and complete the test without any accidents or traffic violations.

questions.question: A blind spot extends at least ____ behind a school bus.

options.text: 10 feet
50 feet
100 feet
1,000 feet

questions.correctAnswerText: 50 feet
questions.explanation: School buses have blind spots below the side mirrors, in front of the side mirrors, and directly behind the rear bumper. Rear blind spots typically extend 50 to 150 feet behind a bus. In some cases, they can extend up to 400 feet depending on the bus length.

questions.question: When crossing railroad tracks, you should:

options.text: Stop on the tracks.
Change gears.
Try to pass.
Stay in your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in your lane.
questions.explanation: When crossing railroad tracks during the on-road driving test, do not stop, change gears, pass another vehicle, or change lanes while any part of your vehicle is on the crossing.

questions.question: When driving on the expressway during the skills test, you should:

options.text: Switch lanes frequently.
Use your mirrors to check traffic as needed.
Drive on the left side of the lane.
Drive above the posted speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your mirrors to check traffic as needed.
questions.explanation: During the on-road driving skills test on an expressway, maintain proper lane position, spacing, and speed. Continuously check your mirrors and look in all directions for traffic.

questions.question: The overhead inside rearview mirror:

options.text: Allows the driver to see what is happening inside of the bus.
Allows the driver to see what is happening outside of the bus.
Monitors traffic.
Opens and closes the door.

questions.correctAnswerText: Allows the driver to see what is happening inside of the bus.
questions.explanation: The overhead inside rearview mirror in a school bus is used to watch passenger activity inside the bus.

questions.question: There are blind spots ____ the left and right side flat mirrors.

options.text: Immediately below
In the middle of
Above
To the left of

questions.correctAnswerText: Immediately below
questions.explanation: There are blind spots immediately below and in front of each outside flat mirror. There is also a blind spot directly behind the rear bumper.

questions.question: During the straight line backing exercise, how many times can you exit the vehicle to check its position?

options.text: One time
Two times
Three times
Four times

questions.correctAnswerText: One time
questions.explanation: During the straight line backing exercise, you can exit your vehicle to check its position no more than one time.

questions.question: After students unload at a school, the driver:

options.text: May assume students have taken all of their belongings with them.
Should assume the students have immediately cleared the doorway.
Should walk through the bus and check for any sleeping or hiding students.
May turn off the dispatch radio.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should walk through the bus and check for any sleeping or hiding students.
questions.explanation: After students exit the bus at a school, the driver should walk through the bus to check for any remaining students who are sleeping or hiding. Also look for items that students may have left behind.
